scope_notes: M-007 is touched (extends base.py TimestampMixin per DS-014; adds 7 ORM models + the alembic migration 0003) even though the roadmap nominally lists S2 as M-002 + M-003 — the new transaction tables must land somewhere and DS-009 says ORM is source-of-truth, so the schema additions live in infrastructure under M-007 while the business logic above is M-002 / M-003.

files.purpose: MODIFY (S1 carry-over). Upgrade TimestampMixin to emit TIMESTAMPTZ (closes TD-007 per DS-014). One-line ORM change; the matching DB ALTERs ship in migration 0003.

functions.name: TimestampMixin
functions.description: created_at column type becomes DateTime(timezone=True) — was plain DateTime in S1. server_default=func.now() retained; ORM behavior of returning timezone-aware datetimes becomes consistent.

files.purpose: SQLAlchemy 2.x ORM models for the 7 new transaction + ledger tables. All headers inherit (Base, TimestampMixin) so created_at is TIMESTAMPTZ after DS-014. Place is denormalized on Inward/Sales headers per DS-013.

functions.name: InwardHeaderModel
functions.description: __tablename__='tbl_inward_header'. Columns: header_id BIGSERIAL PK, purchase_date DATE NOT NULL, supplier_id BIGINT FK→tbl_supplier_master.supplier_id NOT NULL (ondelete RESTRICT), place TEXT NOT NULL (denormalized snapshot of supplier.place at save — DS-013), entered_by_id BIGINT FK→tbl_staff_master.staff_id NOT NULL (RESTRICT), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ. Relationship: lines (one-to-many → InwardLineModel, cascade='all, delete-orphan' at ORM level — no DB CASCADE; AC-027 requires atomicity via service-level transaction). (F-007)

functions.name: InwardLineModel
functions.description: __tablename__='tbl_inward_line'. Columns: line_id BIGSERIAL PK, header_id BIGINT FK→tbl_inward_header.header_id NOT NULL (ondelete CASCADE — DB-level safety for ORM cascade), design_id BIGINT FK→tbl_trading_design_master.design_id NOT NULL (RESTRICT), grade_id BIGINT FK→tbl_grade_master.grade_id NOT NULL (RESTRICT), nos INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(nos > 0) per AC-024. (F-007)

functions.name: SalesHeaderModel
functions.description: __tablename__='tbl_sales_header'. Columns: header_id BIGSERIAL PK, sales_date DATE NOT NULL, dealer_id BIGINT FK→tbl_dealer_master (RESTRICT), place TEXT NOT NULL (denormalized DS-013), loading_staff_id BIGINT FK→tbl_staff_master (RESTRICT) NOT NULL, verified_by_id BIGINT FK→tbl_staff_master (RESTRICT) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ. (F-008)

functions.name: SalesLineModel
functions.description: __tablename__='tbl_sales_line'. Same shape as InwardLineModel with FK back to sales_header. CHECK(nos > 0). (F-008)

functions.name: AdjustmentHeaderModel
functions.description: __tablename__='tbl_adjustment_header'. Columns: header_id BIGSERIAL PK, stock_date DATE NOT NULL, entry_date DATE NOT NULL, design_id BIGINT FK→tbl_trading_design_master (RESTRICT) NOT NULL (single-design per AC-034), entered_by_id BIGINT FK→tbl_staff_master (RESTRICT) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ. CHECK(stock_date <= entry_date) per AC-035 (ERR-010). (F-009)

functions.name: AdjustmentLineModel
functions.description: __tablename__='tbl_adjustment_line'. Columns: line_id BIGSERIAL PK, header_id BIGINT FK→tbl_adjustment_header.header_id NOT NULL (ondelete CASCADE), grade_id BIGINT FK→tbl_grade_master (RESTRICT) NOT NULL, software_cb INTEGER NOT NULL (snapshot from ledger at form-load time per AC-036), physical_cb INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(physical_cb >= 0) per AC-037, difference INTEGER NOT NULL (computed = physical_cb - software_cb per AC-038; persisted, not GENERATED, so it survives ledger recompute). (F-009)

functions.name: StockLedgerModel
functions.description: __tablename__='tbl_stock_ledger'. Columns: ledger_id BIGSERIAL PK, design_id BIGINT FK→tbl_trading_design_master (RESTRICT) NOT NULL, grade_id BIGINT FK→tbl_grade_master (RESTRICT) NOT NULL, txn_date DATE NOT NULL, source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK IN ('inward', 'sale', 'adjustment'), source_header_id BIGINT NULL, source_line_id BIGINT NULL, delta INTEGER NOT NULL (signed: positive for inward, negative for sale, ±difference for adjust), running_balance INTEGER NOT NULL (DS-003 materialized), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ. Indexes: (design_id, grade_id, txn_date DESC, ledger_id DESC) for the latest-as-of-date lookup that closing_balance + opening_balance both need. (M-003)

files.purpose: Alembic revision 0003. (a) ALTERs the 4 existing created_at columns from TIMESTAMP to TIMESTAMPTZ — closes TD-007. (b) Creates the 7 new transaction + ledger tables. (c) Creates indexes including the composite (design_id, grade_id, txn_date DESC, ledger_id DESC) on tbl_stock_ledger.

functions.name: upgrade
functions.description: 1. op.alter_column to TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE on created_at of: tbl_supplier_master, tbl_staff_master, tbl_dealer_master, tbl_trading_design_master. (PostgreSQL preserves data; rewrites column type.) 2. op.create_table for the 6 transaction tables in dependency order (3 headers first, then 3 line tables). 3. op.create_table for tbl_stock_ledger. 4. op.create_index 'ix_stock_ledger_dgt' on (design_id, grade_id, txn_date DESC, ledger_id DESC). 5. CHECK constraints: nos > 0 on the 3 line tables; physical_cb >= 0 on adjustment_line; stock_date <= entry_date on adjustment_header; source_type IN list on stock_ledger.

functions.name: downgrade
functions.description: Drop tbl_stock_ledger and the 6 transaction tables in reverse FK dependency order (lines first, then headers). Revert the 4 TIMESTAMPTZ columns back to TIMESTAMP.

files.purpose: Per-entity repositories for the 7 new tables. Each header repo persists header + lines as a unit (caller is responsible for the surrounding service transaction). StockLedgerRepository encapsulates the SELECT FOR UPDATE + latest-row-by-(design,grade,date) lookup that DS-002 + DS-003 require.

functions.name: InwardHeaderRepository
functions.description: Subclass of BaseRepository[InwardHeaderModel] + create_with_lines(header_payload, line_payloads) → InwardHeaderModel that inserts header + lines in one session.add_all + flush. Caller commits.

functions.name: SalesHeaderRepository
functions.description: Mirror of InwardHeaderRepository for sales.

functions.name: AdjustmentHeaderRepository
functions.description: Mirror with create_with_lines for adjustment + lines.

functions.name: StockLedgerRepository.latest_for_design_grade
functions.description: SELECT FROM tbl_stock_ledger WHERE (design_id, grade_id) ORDER BY txn_date DESC, ledger_id DESC LIMIT 1. If for_update=True, appends FOR UPDATE (DS-002 lock acquisition before write).

functions.name: StockLedgerRepository.latest_as_of
functions.description: SELECT … WHERE (design_id, grade_id) AND txn_date <= as_of_date ORDER BY txn_date DESC, ledger_id DESC LIMIT 1. Drives closing_balance(as_of_date) and opening_balance(month_first_day - 1) lookups per DS-004.

functions.name: StockLedgerRepository.rows_after
functions.description: SELECT … WHERE (design_id, grade_id) AND txn_date >= after_date_inclusive ORDER BY txn_date ASC, ledger_id ASC. Drives the back-dated-transaction forward-recompute loop. Bounded by AC-021's 7-day window so this list is small (≤ ~30 rows at realistic throughput per DS-003).

functions.name: StockLedgerRepository.insert
functions.description: Construct + add + flush. Caller commits. Used by domain.stock.apply_* functions.

files.purpose: M-003 core. Pure functions over the stock ledger that handle: SELECT FOR UPDATE serialization, materialized running_balance write, back-dated-transaction forward-recompute (DS-003), and on-read carry-forward lookup (DS-004). No HTTP, no Pydantic — application services compose these primitives inside their own transaction.

functions.name: apply_inward
functions.description: delta = +nos. (1) Acquires SELECT FOR UPDATE on the latest row for (design_id, grade_id) via repo.latest_for_design_grade(for_update=True). (2) Computes new running_balance = prior_balance + delta. (3) Inserts the new ledger row with source_type='inward'. (4) If date < prior_row.txn_date (back-dated), invokes _recompute_forward to update running_balance on every later row for the same (design, grade).

functions.name: apply_sale
functions.description: Same shape as apply_inward with delta = -nos, source_type='sale'. NOTE: V1 does NOT block negative running_balance — PRD has no oversell-prevention AC; the ledger faithfully records reality. Document as DS-013-adjacent note.

functions.name: apply_adjustment
functions.description: delta = difference (can be negative or positive per AC-038), source_type='adjustment'. Same locking + forward-recompute shape as apply_inward.

functions.name: closing_balance
functions.description: Returns repo.latest_as_of(design_id, grade_id, as_of_date).running_balance if a row exists, else 0. O(1) lookup thanks to ix_stock_ledger_dgt + DS-003 materialization. This is the function the Adjustment form's GET /designs/{id}/grades-with-cb endpoint calls per AC-036.

functions.name: opening_balance
functions.description: Returns closing_balance(design_id, grade_id, month_first_day - 1 day) per DS-004 / FORMULA-002. AC-042 first-month case is naturally satisfied because there are no prior ledger rows.

functions.name: _recompute_forward
functions.description: Private. Loads rows_after for (design, grade, from_date_inclusive) ordered ascending; replays delta on each in order, updating running_balance. Bounded by the 7-day backdate window per AC-021. Mutates rows in-session; caller commits.

files.purpose: F-007 use case. Validates date bounds + minimum-line-RULE then writes header + lines + per-line ledger rows in one SQLAlchemy transaction.

functions.name: InwardService.save_inward
functions.description: (1) Validate purchase_date: today() - 7 ≤ purchase_date ≤ today() per AC-020/AC-021 (ERR-001/ERR-002). (2) Fetch supplier + assert is_active; auto-populate place from supplier.place per AC-022. (3) Filter line list: drop rows where nos is None or 0 per AC-025. Reject if zero lines remain per AC-026. (4) For each remaining line, assert design+grade are active AND (design_id, grade_id) ∈ active design_grade_map (AC-023 contract). (5) Persist header + filtered lines via InwardHeaderRepository.create_with_lines. (6) For each persisted line, invoke domain.stock.apply_inward inside the SAME session — the SELECT FOR UPDATE serializes per (design, grade). (7) session.commit. (8) Return hydrated InwardRead.

functions.name: InwardService.list_inwards
functions.description: Admin read — not strictly required by S2 ACs but needed for the basic ledger read API. Returns headers + nested lines.

files.purpose: F-008 use case. Same shape as inward_service with sales-specific fields (dealer, loading_staff, verified_by) and delta = -nos.

functions.name: SalesService.save_sale
functions.description: Mirror of save_inward with: AC-028 date bounds (sales_date) per ERR-001/ERR-002; AC-029 dealer→place denormalize; AC-030 both loading_staff_id and verified_by_id required AND active; AC-031/AC-032 line validations identical to inward; delegates to domain.stock.apply_sale (delta = -nos).

functions.name: SalesService.list_sales
functions.description: Filtered list — S3's Sales Report (M-005) will reuse this query backbone. Filters all optional per RULE-018 (S3) but exposed here for the admin read path.

files.purpose: F-009 use case. Differs from inward/sales: single-design per AC-034, software_cb pre-populated at form-load, difference applied to ledger.

functions.name: AdjustmentService.save_adjustment
functions.description: (1) Validate stock_date <= entry_date per AC-035 (ERR-010). (2) Assert design exists + is_active. (3) Resolve active (design, grade) pairs via DesignGradeMapRepository.list_active_by_design; reject (ERR-012) per AC-040 if none. (4) For each submitted line: snapshot the *current* software_cb from domain.stock.closing_balance(design, grade, stock_date); compute difference = physical_cb - software_cb per AC-038; persist the adjustment line with both values; invoke domain.stock.apply_adjustment with delta=difference. Skipping logic mirrors inward (RULE-017 — though for Adjustment the user explicitly enters physical_cb=0; only 'blank' is skipped, NOT zero per AC-037). (5) session.commit; return hydrated AdjustmentRead.

files.purpose: Service for GET /designs/{id}/grades-with-cb — Adjustment form's grade-row pre-populator (AC-036 + HLD DF-003). Returns active mappings projected as {grade_id, grade_code, software_cb} where software_cb = closing_balance(design, grade, stock_date).

functions.name: DesignGradeCbService.list_active_grades_with_cb
functions.description: (1) Asserts design exists and is_active (NotFoundError otherwise). (2) Calls DesignGradeMapRepository.list_active_by_design (T-006 — also filters grade.is_active, AC-012 cascade still holds for S2). (3) Projects each row + domain.stock.closing_balance(design_id, row.grade_id, stock_date) → DesignGradeReadWithCb. (4) Returns []. ERR-012 (no active grades) is the empty-list path; the router converts to 422 per HLD.

files.purpose: Pydantic v2 schemas for the 3 transaction forms and the GET /designs/{id}/grades-with-cb response.

functions.name: InwardLineCreate
functions.description: Fields: design_id (gt=0), grade_id (gt=0), nos (Field default=None, ge=0 — None and 0 are 'skip' per RULE-017). Service strips skipped rows before validating nos > 0 (AC-024).

functions.name: InwardCreate
functions.description: Fields: purchase_date (date), supplier_id (gt=0), entered_by_id (gt=0), lines (list[InwardLineCreate], min_length=1 per RULE-015). place is NOT in the request — derived from supplier on server (AC-022 — read-only / not user-editable).

functions.name: InwardLineRead / InwardRead
functions.description: Response shapes. InwardRead embeds list[InwardLineRead]. ConfigDict from_attributes=True.

functions.name: SalesLineCreate / SalesCreate / SalesLineRead / SalesRead
functions.description: Same shape as inward family with dealer_id, loading_staff_id, verified_by_id additions. place derived server-side from dealer.

functions.name: AdjustmentLineCreate
functions.description: Fields: grade_id (gt=0), physical_cb (int, ge=0). software_cb is NOT in the request — service snapshots at save time per AC-036 narrative ('the system pulls software CB as of stock_date').

functions.name: AdjustmentCreate
functions.description: Fields: stock_date (date), entry_date (date), design_id (gt=0), entered_by_id (gt=0), lines (list[AdjustmentLineCreate], min_length=1). Cross-field validator: stock_date <= entry_date (AC-035).

functions.name: AdjustmentLineRead / AdjustmentRead
functions.description: Response shapes including software_cb + difference fields.

functions.name: DesignGradeReadWithCb
functions.description: {grade_id: int, grade_code: str, software_cb: int} — Adjustment form's grade-row pre-populator. DF-003 contract.

files.purpose: MODIFY (S1 router). Add GET /designs/{design_id}/grades-with-cb endpoint for the Adjustment form's pre-population. Existing /designs CRUD + /designs/{id}/grades endpoints untouched.

functions.name: list_grades_with_cb_for_design
functions.description: GET /designs/{design_id}/grades-with-cb?stock_date=YYYY-MM-DD → 200 [{grade_id, grade_code, software_cb}, …] using DesignGradeCbService. Returns [] when no active grade combinations — the router does NOT convert to 422 because per AC-040 the FORM blocks save with ERR-012, not the endpoint; an empty response is the contract.

functions.name: get_inward_service / get_sales_service / get_adjustment_service / get_design_grade_cb_service

functions.description: Add: include_router(inward.router, prefix='/api/v1'); include_router(sales.router, prefix='/api/v1'); include_router(adjustments.router, prefix='/api/v1'). frontend_ui_track_note: The 3 transaction form UIs (Inward, Sales, Adjustment) and their dependencies (transaction TypeScript types, axios wrappers, react-hook-form + zod schemas, design+grade dropdowns, datepicker) are NOT enumerated in this LLD — they ship via the UI track (/ases-ui-design S2 → /ases-ui-review S2 → /ases-ui-scaffold S2) which reads this LLD's API contracts and produces a standalone frontend scaffold. The integration_points the UI track will need: POST /api/v1/inward, POST /api/v1/sales, POST /api/v1/adjustments, GET /api/v1/designs/{id}/grades-with-cb, plus the existing S1 GET /api/v1/designs/{id}/grades for grade-row auto-population (AC-023 / AC-031).
